The '''Sentry Droid X-5''' was a model of [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], a number of them were used to defend the assembly line of the factory during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sentry Droid X-5s appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Assembly Line of the Okara Droid Factory, a Heroic area, on the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
